baseFrontend: validated Admin 7 runtime with scrollable native cockpit, clean placeholder login and verified ioBroker password writes
label: v98
notes: The native cockpit keeps the fixed header and provides an explicit vertical content scrollbar.
The login uses clean placeholder fields without overlapping MUI outline labels and expands for errors.
Password reset writes the real ioBroker user password to nexowatt and forces personal password setup.
First-login password changes are verified through the ioBroker password API before success is shown.
EOS Assist remains disabled until its separate complete redesign.
changes: Normalized system.user.* ids to the short account names expected by setPasswordAsync and checkPasswordAsync.
Separated password hash writes from EOS native metadata updates to prevent stale object replacement.
Relaxed same-host origin handling for reverse proxies while rejecting cross-site requests.
Added a stable vertical scroll surface to the overview and preserved the working EMS live diagnosis.
Removed floating login labels from the productive bundle and introduced clean accessible placeholders.
